tools.name: agentic.readiness_probe
tools.description: Run a one-time readiness check on a public storefront and return a score, a grade and per-check results (UCP and ACP discovery files, product schema, robots rules, answer-engine maps). The result is a dated snapshot of public files, not an attested Store Guard grade. Input: url, a public storefront

tools.name: dispatch.quote
tools.description: Request a field-service quote by trade, location, and urgency. Returns availability and quote details when available. Accepts a provisioned integration key through x-api-key or, when OAuth is enabled, a scoped self-serve OAuth token through Authorization: Bearer. MCP also accepts the provisioned key

tools.name: dispatch.estimate
tools.description: Public modeled field-service price estimate with cited BLS wage benchmarks. Returns customer hourly rates, line items, ranges and a total alongside geographic scope and source provenance. Model estimates are not observed transaction prices or binding quotes. Use dispatch.quote with an accepted crede

tools.name: dispatch.evals
tools.description: Return the public evaluation document for a selected rolling window. Consult its per-field provenance and methodology to distinguish self-reported estimates, measurements, and unavailable fields. It is not an independent audit or a service-level guarantee. No API key required.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agentic.readiness_probe, dispatch.quote, dispatch.order, dispatch.order_status, acp.validate, ucp.validate · Private data: agentic.readiness_probe, dispatch.quote, dispatch.estimate, dispatch.order, dispatch.order_status, dispatch.evals, dispatch.index, acp.validate, ucp.validate · Public sink: dispatch.quote, dispatch.order, dispatch.order_status · Destructive: agentic.readiness_probe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agentic.readiness_probe, dispatch.quote, dispatch.order, dispatch.order_status, acp.validate, ucp.validate · Private data: agentic.readiness_probe, dispatch.quote, dispatch.estimate, dispatch.order, dispatch.order_status, dispatch.evals, dispatch.index, acp.validate, ucp.validate · Public sink: dispatch.quote, dispatch.order, dispatch.order_status · Destructive: agentic.readiness_probe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
